4613-5475-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Forensic Researcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-5475-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5475-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2173-4574-6495-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-6495-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

64-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
64-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Warden of the Eye and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
64-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Warden of the Eye and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

6155-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Arid Mesa.
6155-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Arid Mesa.
When Arid Mesa enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Arid Mesa by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

1417-2438-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

2178-4147-4294-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4294-6797.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

331-791-3693-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-3693-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.

When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

1329-1750-2793-5261-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.

Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Burning Anger attached to Phyrexian Colossus.

Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating four Treasure tokens.

790-1972-4651.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
